_comment: Mobile Android regression. TWO-STEP RUN — the API only reproduces step 1. Step 1 (this spec) = Folder Mobile + Active + Regression/Smoke, excluding automation types Automated(10) and Automated-Android(23) → 215 cases as of 2026-10-28 (191 on 2026-07-22). STEP 2 IS MANUAL: after creating this run, in the Testmo UI clear the filters, select Configuration = iOS, and REMOVE those from the run. The net after step 2 has not been re-captured since 2026-07-22 (~154 then, a -37 subtraction); expect it to be higher now. Reason: Testmo's /cases API cannot filter by configuration and exposes no per-case config assignment, so the iOS-config subtraction cannot be automated. config_id 1 = Android.
